== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and Errata / PC Errata articles of this Decipher-era family. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata · PC Errata only when those faces exist. Do not add Unlimited, Japanese, foil, Two-Player, or (V) columns. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
